title: Good Morning, Gorillas
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie learn to 'talk' with gorillas using sign language in an African rain forest! / 杰克和安妮在非洲雨林里用手语和大猩猩「聊天」！🦍

q.en: Where does the magic tree house take Jack and Annie this time?
q.zh: 这一次，魔法树屋把杰克和安妮带到了哪里？

options.en: San Francisco in 1906, though that is another story

explain.en: Their book is titled An African Rain Forest, and Jack reads that the misty mountain forest is called a 'cloud forest.'
explain.zh: 他们的书名叫《非洲雨林》，杰克读到，山上那片雾蒙蒙的雨林被称为「云雾林」。

q.en: What 'special language' do Jack and Annie use with the gorillas?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮用哪种「特别的语言」和大猩猩交流？

options.en: Using a secret code of clicks and hums
options.zh: 用咔哒声和低吟组成的秘密暗号

explain.en: Morgan's rhyme says 'talk with your hands and heart'; Annie signs 'I love you' and the little gorillas try to copy it — a special language.
explain.zh: 摩根的谜语说「用你的手和心说话」；安妮比出「我爱你」的手语，小猩猩也学着做——这就是一种特别的语言。

q.en: What does Annie name the small gorilla who says 'Bu, bu'?
q.zh: 安妮给那只会说「布，布」的小猩猩起了什么名字？

explain.en: The small gorilla peeks out saying 'Bu, bu?' and Annie happily names her Bu-bu.
explain.zh: 小猩猩探出头来说「布，布？」，安妮开心地给她起名叫布布。

q.en: Who is the leader of the gorilla family?
q.zh: 大猩猩一家是谁在领头？

options.en: The mother gorilla who cares for the baby
options.zh: 照顾猩猩宝宝的猩猩妈妈
银背，一只巨大的雄猩猩

explain.en: The biggest gorilla has black and silver fur and is the family's leader, a 'silverback'; Annie calls him Big Guy.
explain.zh: 最大那只猩猩长着黑中带银的毛，是一家之主，也就是「银背」；安妮叫他大块头。

q.en: When Jack got lost in the dark rainy forest, who led him to Annie?
q.zh: 杰克在漆黑下雨的森林里迷路时，是谁把他带到了安妮身边？

options.en: A friendly little bird in the trees
options.zh: 树林里一只友善的小鸟

explain.en: In the dawn light, Bu-bu finds Jack, waves her arms, and leads him to where Annie is asleep among the sleeping gorillas.
explain.zh: 在黎明的微光里，布布找到了杰克，挥着胳膊把他领到安妮身旁——安妮正和睡着的大猩猩们躺在一起。

q.en: How did Jack scare away the hungry black leopard?
q.zh: 杰克是怎样把那只饥饿的黑豹吓跑的？

options.en: He swung from branch to branch like a monkey
options.zh: 他像猴子一样在树枝间荡来荡去

options.en: He climbed a tall tree to hide
options.zh: 他爬到一棵大树上躲起来

options.en: He called for Annie to help
He acted like a silverback gorilla
options.zh: 他学银背大猩猩的样子

explain.en: Jack copies the silverback's display — hooting, shaking a limb, beating his chest, and roaring 'WRAAGH!' — and the leopard leaves.
explain.zh: 杰克学银背的样子——呼啸、摇晃树枝、捶打胸口，还大吼「哇啊！」——黑豹就走掉了。

q.en: What sign did Annie teach the little gorillas?
q.zh: 安妮教小猩猩们比的是什么手语？

explain.en: Annie lifts her thumb, index finger, and little finger to sign 'I love you,' and Bu-bu and Ho-ho try to make the same sign.
explain.zh: 安妮竖起大拇指、食指和小指，比出「我爱你」；布布和霍霍也试着做出同样的样子。

q.en: What do mountain gorillas mostly eat?
q.zh: 山地大猩猩主要吃什么？

options.en: Fresh fish from the cold river

explain.en: Jack reads that gorillas are shy, gentle giants who do not hunt; they mainly eat the plant growth of the forest.
explain.zh: 杰克读到，大猩猩是害羞温和的巨兽，不会捕猎，主要以森林里的植物为食。

q.en: What do Jack and Annie bring home as proof of 'gorilla magic'?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮带回什么，作为「大猩猩魔法」的证明？

options.en: A twig that little Ho-ho gave Jack
options.zh: 小霍霍送给杰克的树枝

options.en: A handwritten note from Morgan le Fay
options.zh: 摩根·勒·菲写的一张字条

explain.en: Little Ho-ho offers Jack a twig to eat; Jack saves it and places it by the scrolls from England as proof of the magic of animals.
explain.zh: 小霍霍递给杰克一根树枝让他吃；杰克把它留下来，和从英格兰带回的卷轴放在一起，作为动物魔法的证明。

q.en: As they say good-bye, what does the silverback sign to Jack and Annie?
q.zh: 道别时，银背大猩猩向杰克和安妮比出了什么手势？

explain.en: The silverback raises his thumb, index finger, and little finger and signs 'I love you' before turning away with his family.
explain.zh: 银背竖起大拇指、食指和小指，比出「我爱你」，然后带着家群转身离去。
